title: Christmas gifts for your boyfriend 2026: 11 he'll use (UK)
seoTitle: Gifts for Boyfriend Christmas 2026 UK: 11 Ideas
description: Christmas gifts for your boyfriend in 2026 at UK Black Friday prices: Bose earbuds £99, Sony WH-1000XM6 £298, Philips OneBlade £39.99 and more.
intro:
**Our best Christmas gift for a boyfriend this year is the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds at £99, a record low at Amazon. Best cheap pick: the Philips OneBlade 360 at £39.99. Best splurge: Sony's WH-1000XM6 headphones at £298.**

Every price below was published on 21 November 2026, during Amazon's Black Friday Week (to 30 November), so check the product page before you buy. Some prices need Prime. For more ideas, see all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

deals.name: Sony WH-1000XM6 noise-cancelling headphones
deals.note: Our best splurge: Sony's newest flagship over-ears, with class-leading noise cancelling for commutes, flights and gaming. £101 off at Amazon (TechRadar, 21 November).

deals.name: Apple Watch Series 11 (46mm, GPS)
deals.note: For an iPhone owner who wants workout tracking and notifications on his wrist. This price is for the Purple Fog and Silver finishes; others may cost more. More in our [Apple Watch deals guide](/guides/apple-watch-deals-uk/).

deals.name: Amazon Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition (2024, 32GB)
deals.note: A record low for the top Paperwhite, with wireless charging and an auto-adjusting light. Add a [Kindle Unlimited free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/kindle-dbs/hz/subscribe/ku) so he has books to read on Christmas Day.

deals.name: Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 bone-conduction headphones
deals.note: Open-ear headphones that leave him able to hear traffic, which is why runners and cyclists like them. TechRadar says this is their lowest price ever.

deals.name: Bose QuietComfort Earbuds
deals.note: Strong noise cancelling in a pocketable case, at a record-low price. A good pick if he already has over-ear headphones or wants something for the gym.

deals.name: Apple AirTag 4-pack (2nd generation)
deals.note: For the man who's always losing his keys, wallet or bag. Works with an iPhone's Find My app. Four for £74 is £18.50 each.

deals.name: Hugo Boss Boss Bottled EDT 100ml festive gift set
deals.note: A classic, crowd-pleasing aftershave in a gift box, 40% off at John Lewis (T3, 21 November). Use the Amazon link below to compare before you buy.

deals.name: Lego Star Wars Millennium Falcon (75375)
deals.note: A 900-odd-piece model of the Falcon, made to sit on a shelf. A good evening build if he's a Star Wars fan. See our [Lego Black Friday guide](/guides/lego-black-friday-deals-2026/) for more sets.

deals.name: Sony DualSense wireless controller (PS5)
deals.note: A second controller is the PS5 owner's most useful upgrade, so you can play together. For Xbox, the wireless controller is £39.99. More in [gifts for gamers](/guides/gifts-for-gamers-uk/).

deals.name: Philips OneBlade 360
deals.note: Trims, edges and shaves with one tool, so it suits a beard or stubble. Blades are cheap to replace and last a few months each.

deals.name: Oral-B iO Series 3 electric toothbrush
deals.note: Not romantic, but a big upgrade on a manual brush, at a fraction of the usual price. Best as a practical extra next to a fun main present.

body:
## Best Christmas gifts for your boyfriend at a glance

- **Best overall:** Bose QuietComfort Earbuds, £99 at Amazon
- **Best cheap:** Philips OneBlade 360, £39.99 at Amazon
- **Best splurge:** Sony WH-1000XM6 headphones, £298 at Amazon
- **Best for runners:** Shokz OpenRun Pro 2, £126 at Amazon
- **Best for readers:** Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition, £139.99 at Amazon
- **Best for gamers:** PS5 DualSense controller, £42.99 at Amazon
- **Best aftershave:** Boss Bottled gift set, £54.60 at John Lewis

## How to choose a gift for your boyfriend

**Start with what he does most.** The best presents are things he'll use every week: headphones for the commute, a running headset, a shaver, a controller for the console he already owns. A list of his hobbies is more useful than any gift list, including this one.

**Upgrade something he already uses.** Many men will happily use the same cheap earbuds or the same blunt razor for years. Replacing that with a better version (Bose earbuds, a OneBlade) feels thoughtful, because you've noticed.

**Check the ecosystem.** The Apple Watch and AirTags need an iPhone. The DualSense controller is for PS5 only. Shokz and Sony headphones work with any phone. If you're not sure what he uses, the headphones are the safe choice.

**Mix one main gift with a small one.** A spread like this works well: something bigger around £100 (earbuds or a Kindle), and a smaller extra around £40 to £50 (the Lego Millennium Falcon or a gift set). For more budget ideas, see our [Christmas gifts for him under £50](/guides/christmas-gifts-for-him-under-50/).

## Which headphones should I buy him?

- **Sony WH-1000XM6 (£298):** the best over-ear noise cancelling, for long flights and an open-plan office. Big, though.
- **Bose QuietComfort Earbuds (£99):** most of that noise cancelling in a pocket-sized case. Our best value pick.
- **Shokz OpenRun Pro 2 (£126):** not noise cancelling at all. They sit on the cheekbones so he can hear cars and other runners. Only for sport.

If he's a gamer who plays with a headset, a Sony controller and the Bose buds together still cost less than the XM6.

## What's a good price?

From this year's Black Friday prices:

- Sony WH-1000XM6: under £300 is a strong price for a current flagship
- Bose QuietComfort Earbuds: £99 is a record low
- Kindle Paperwhite Signature Edition: under £140 is a record low
- PS5 DualSense: around £43 is a good price; under £40 is rare
- Philips OneBlade 360: £40 or less

## When do prices drop?

These prices come from Amazon's Black Friday Week, which runs to Cyber Monday on 30 November. Prices rarely drop further before Christmas, and they often rise again in December. If you've found the right present, buy it now. Many Amazon Black Friday prices are for Prime members, and a [Prime free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/amazonprime) also covers delivery in time for Christmas.

If he loves podcasts or audiobooks, an [Audible free trial](https://www.amazon.co.uk/hz/audible/mlp) is a nice extra, and costs nothing in the first month.

Still stuck? Try [gifts for men who have everything](/guides/gifts-for-men-who-have-everything-uk/), or browse all our [Christmas gift guides](/christmas-gifts/).

### What should I get my boyfriend for Christmas 2026?

Something he'll use daily. For most men, a good pair of noise-cancelling earbuds like the Bose QuietComfort Earbuds (£99) is a safe, well-liked choice. For a sporty boyfriend, the Shokz OpenRun Pro 2.

### How much should I spend on my boyfriend for Christmas?

There's no right number. Many couples agree a budget in advance, which takes the pressure off. This list has good gifts from about £40 up to £300.

### What is a good cheap gift for a boyfriend?

The Philips OneBlade 360 at £39.99, a PS5 or Xbox controller at around £40, or the Lego Millennium Falcon at about £50 for a Star Wars fan.

### Is the Apple Watch worth it as a gift?

Only if he has an iPhone, as it won't work with Android. If he does, the Series 11 at £290 is a big but well-used present.

### Will these be cheaper on Cyber Monday?

Unlikely. Amazon tends to keep the same prices through to 30 November, and popular items can sell out first.
